diff --git a/catalog/cart.py b/catalog/cart.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4513660
--- /dev/null
+++ b/catalog/cart.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Cart pricing."""
+
+
+def price_line(index, line):
+    product = index.get(line["sku"])
+    if product is None:
+        return None
+    return product.price_cents * int(line["qty"])
+
+
+def priced(index, lines):
+    return [line for line in lines if price_line(index, line) is not None]
diff --git a/catalog/inventory.py b/catalog/inventory.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2838066
--- /dev/null
+++ b/catalog/inventory.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Stock adjustments from the warehouse feed."""
+
+
+def apply(index, adjustments):
+    applied = []
+    for adjustment in adjustments:
+        product = index.get(adjustment["sku"])
+        if product is None:
+            continue
+        product.on_hand += int(adjustment["delta"])
+        applied.append(adjustment["sku"])
+    return applied
diff --git a/catalog/search.py b/catalog/search.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e9e03c8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/catalog/search.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+"""Product search by SKU."""
+
+
+def lookup(index, query):
+    return index.get(query)
+
+
+def hits(index, queries):
+    return [q for q in queries if lookup(index, q) is not None]
prompt:
Support ticket 4417: a customer followed a bookmark to OLD-8842, got "no such
product", and bought the equivalent from somebody else. They pasted the URL and
it is a perfectly good SKU in the catalog.

Fix it so a lookup like that resolves. `python run.py` must complete and the
reconciliation numbers it prints have to be right.

Do not change anything under `data/`, and do not change the report's line
shapes — the ops dashboard parses them.
